raw_response:
This rice plot is small, less than half a hectare, but rice needs water and care or it gives you nothing. I have some cash from my other plots since my whole farm is big, so I can buy one bag of fertilizer for this rice — urea is what everybody uses on rice here, you put it when the rice is growing. I do not buy improved seed every year, I keep seed from last harvest like my father did, it grows well enough in our lowland. I will not pay for pesticide, I just walk the plot and pull the weeds with my wife and children, and the birds we chase with shouting.
